hinweis: All times in seconds, relative to the start of the MP4 file (not to trimStart). Clips: 1920x1080, 24 fps, 5.04 s, silent. Bundle version: file names are flat (Xcode copies App/Resources into the bundle without subfolders), fallback still as a 1920x1080 JPEG, end frames not included. Source with subfolders and end frames: the editing copy kept outside the repository.
hinweisTon: ton: file in the bundle, plays at bellAt. doorbell.m4a is generated by scripts/doorbell.py (synthetic, no licensing question).
hinweisSaisons: A seasonal intro needs only files in App/Resources/Intro and an entry here, no code. Example: {"id": "weihnachten", "von": "12-20", "bis": "12-26", "clips": [{"id": "waschbaer-weihnachten", "file": "intro-waschbaer-weihnachten.mp4", "bellAt": 1.5, "reactionAt": 1.7, "exitAt": 4.62, "trimStart": 1.1, "cardsAt": 4.4, "ton": "doorbell.m4a"}]}. von/bis are MM-DD and include both days; bis before von spans the turn of the year. The first valid season wins; if a file is missing, startup falls back to the default clips.
